expo.name: FRESH CART
expo.description: Fresh cart is Rwanda’s all-in-one platform to discover, book, and order from local restaurants, supermarkets, salons, and service providers. Enjoy convenient bookings, secure payments, and effortless access to the best businesses in Kigali and beyond.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fresh cart uses your location to help you find nearby restaurants, salons, and local businesses for a better booking experience.

web.description: Discover and book your favorite restaurants, supermarkets, and local services with Fresh cart — your gateway to Kigali’s best experiences.

about.mission: Empowering local businesses and simplifying daily life for Rwandans through a seamless digital platform.
about.vision: To become Rwanda’s leading booking and service marketplace, transforming the way people connect with local businesses.
